entries.look: Career → Chapters. Open each chapter tab in turn and let its picture draw in (SCCA's circuits trace themselves in date order; F1600's podiums fill; Formula Ford's rain falls; FR Oceania's dots run from start slot to finish slot). Point at (or tap) any race, column, step or grid: its card, with the track's 3D still; click (or tap again) to open the race. Daytona: the dial starts at the top at the 1:40 pm start, the shaded wedge is the night, his three spells are the thick arcs.
